title: From Training Exposure to Membership Evidence: A Controlled Study of OLMo 2
abstract: arXiv:2610.41732v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Whether a language model was trained on a document matters for copyright, privacy, and benchmark contamination. Yet most membership-inference (MI) evaluations on language models collect members and non-members after the fact, so success may reflect distribution shift and failure is inconclusive. We re-ran OLMo 2 1B's official 50-billion-token mid-training stage, replacing selected training chunks with documents from 7,814 pairs matched on domain and difficulty. For each pair, a coin flip determined which document was inserted and which was held out. The run released by the Allen Institute for AI (AI2) from the same seed saw identical data everywhere else and serves as the counterfactual. One exposure raises a previously unseen document's likelihood on average but rarely identifies it. translated_title: 从训练暴露到成员证据：OLMo 2 的受控研究
translated_abstract: 语言模型是否在某个文档上进行过训练，这对版权、隐私和基准污染等问题至关重要。然而，大多数针对语言模型的成员推断（MI）评估都是在事后收集成员和非成员数据，因此成功的推断可能仅仅反映了分布偏移，而失败也无法得出明确结论。我们重新运行了 OLMo 2 1B 的官方 500 亿 token 中期训练阶段，用来自 7,814 对在领域和难度上相匹配的文档替换了选定的训练数据块。对于每一对文档，通过抛硬币决定哪一个被插入训练、哪一个被保留。由 Allen Institute for AI（AI2）发布的相同种子的运行结果在其他所有数据上都完全一致，可作为反事实参照。单次暴露平均会提高一个先前未见文档的似然，但很少能准确识别出该文档。以反事实运行作为参照，参考比率的 ROC 曲线下面积（AUC）为 0.767，但在跨领域使用单一阈值时，捕获（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究通过受控地重新运行 OLMo 2 1B 的 500 亿 token 中期训练，并利用同种子发布的运行作为反事实参照，首次严格量化了单次训练暴露所提供的成员证据——单次暴露平均会提高文档似然，但很少能可靠地识别出训练成员。
en_tdlr: By re-running OLMo 2 1B's 50-billion-token mid-training with coin-flip-controlled document insertions and using AI2's same-seed released run as a counterfactual, this study provides the first rigorous measurement of how much membership evidence a single training exposure actually provides—raising a document's likelihood on average but rarely identifying it reliably.
